game.title: Dopamine
game.blurb: A frontend-only web arcade satire of the attention economy. Survive on stimulation across competing fictional digital services until Dopamine hits zero.

disclaimer: Dopamine is satire. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any real social network, streaming service, operating system, or platform.
providersNotice: Optional media providers (Pixabay, Pexels, Jamendo, Freesound) stay disabled until keys and legal review are OK. Local content/ packs are the default shipping path.
